candidates.pricing: Free official desktop application under GNU GPL; no recurring software fee is required. This is free software, not evidence of a paid perpetual license.
candidates.tradeoff: GIMP supports photo retouching and layered composition. Camera RAW processing uses external plug-ins. CMYK import/export uses RGB storage; a native CMYK editing workflow is not established by this review. PSD fidelity and Photoshop feature parity are not guaranteed.
candidates.platforms: Official GNU/Linux, macOS and Windows desktop downloads; check current OS and hardware requirements.
candidates.scopeDescription: Desktop raster layers, painting and basic image adjustment only. GIMP is reviewed for retouching and layered composition; RAW processing uses external plug-ins and native CMYK editing is outside the reviewed scope. No guarantee of full Photoshop, PSD, print-production, automation, AI or team-workflow parity.

candidates.pricing: Free official GPL desktop application without a recurring software fee. Optional paid store distributions support development and automatic updates; store terms are separate.
candidates.tradeoff: Krita specializes in digital painting rather than complete Photoshop image manipulation. Layer compositing, text and filters can differ. Its manual documents PSD loading/saving with supported elements but warns against assuming complete compatibility; review exchanged files.
candidates.platforms: Official Windows, macOS and Linux desktop downloads. Android builds are separate; iPhone and iPad are not supported according to the download page.
candidates.scopeDescription: Desktop raster layers, painting and basic image adjustment only. Krita is reviewed primarily for illustration and digital painting, not comprehensive photographic retouching. PSD and text/layer semantics need review. No guarantee of full Photoshop, print-production, automation, AI or team-workflow parity.

candidates.pricing: Free Classic desktop release with no recurring software fee. The Microsoft Store release is paid; the official license describes the same functionality except automatic updating. This is proprietary freeware, not open source.
candidates.tradeoff: Windows-only desktop editor with layers, drawing, selections, effects and color adjustments. PDN is its native layered format; extra file formats may require plugins. This review does not establish native PSD round-trip or professional print/RAW parity. Check current CPU/GPU requirements.
candidates.platforms: Windows 11, Windows 10 21H2 or newer, or Windows Server 2022; check official 64-bit CPU and Direct3D 11 requirements.
candidates.scopeDescription: Desktop raster layers, painting and basic image adjustment only. Paint.NET is reviewed for Windows layers, selections, drawing and color adjustments. PDN is its native layered format; plugin formats do not prove PSD compatibility. No guarantee of full Photoshop, print-production, RAW, automation, AI or team-workflow parity.
